parsedVerdict.reasoning: UserController is an Express HTTP adapter in the infrastructure layer, and everything it does is transport work. In create(), it pulls the 'name' field out of the request body, passes it to CreateUserUseCase.execute, sends the result back as a 201 JSON response, and forwards errors to next(). The stringField helper only checks the shape of the untyped request body and defaults to an empty string. That is parsing input at the transport boundary, not a business rule: it doesn't validate the name, enforce any invariant or make a domain decision, and it leaves those to the application or domain layer. The file contains no persistence logic, no domain rules and no orchestration of several use cases. Its responsibilities fit an infrastructure/presentation adapter.
